product_one_liner.value: Jack & Jill provides AI career and recruiting agents that match jobseekers with employers and introduce suitable candidates directly to hiring teams.
product_one_liner.notes: The company announcement at https://www.jackandjill.ai/blog/series-a describes Jack as a career agent, Jill as a hiring agent, and their joint introduction of matching candidates and companies.

pricing_page.notes: The public page at https://www.jackandjill.ai/pricing/us lists free offerings and Hire Jill pricing from $199 per active role per month.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Fyxer and Maze appear in the customer logo wall on https://www.jackandjill.ai/pricing/us, alongside the statement that the product is trusted by more than 2,000 startups. | named_customers.0: Fyxer appears in the customer logo wall and associated founder testimonial on https://www.jackandjill.ai/pricing/us. | named_customers.1: Maze is named in the trusted-customer logo wall on https://www.jackandjill.ai/pricing/us.

employee_band.notes: The company states 'We're 28 people' at https://www.jackandjill.ai/about-us, placing it in 21-50. This direct company statement is preferred over a conflicting LinkedIn employee tally.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company's posting at https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/jack-jill-external-ats/050c78ca-62c8-44c0-ac3d-925b7a8a8aa3 explicitly says it is headquartered in London. | hq_country: The company's posting at https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/jack-jill-external-ats/050c78ca-62c8-44c0-ac3d-925b7a8a8aa3 explicitly places headquarters in London. Its careers listings at https://www.jackandjill.ai/about-us identify London as being in the UK, supporting United Kingdom.

founded_year.notes: The company profile at https://linkedin.com/company/jackandjillai lists its founding year as 2025. This is a profile-reported date.

eng_blog.notes: The complete index at https://www.jackandjill.ai/blog contains product announcements, company news, hiring advice and career guidance. It does not show two engineer-authored articles about building the product, and has no engineering category.

public_docs.notes: The public documentation hub at https://www.jackandjill.ai/docs links to multiple product articles, including overview, onboarding and candidate discovery, as well as numerous integration guides.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The open-role list at https://www.jackandjill.ai/about-us includes design, account executives, founding engineering, operations, GTM engineering, finance and community roles. None has a qualifying AI, ML or data-science title; general engineering work on an AI product does not qualify.

model_provider.notes: The case study at https://typesafe.ai/blog/jack-jill-jev-case-study states that Jack & Jill deployed TypeSafe's Jev in production, replacing Gemini for a candidate-matching stage, and includes a supporting quote attributed to CEO Matthew Wilson. The evidence is vendor-published rather than hosted by Jack & Jill.

compliance_certs.notes: The legal page at https://jackandjill.ai/terms and company-specific assurance page at https://trust.warden-ai.com/jackandjill/ai-candidate-matching do not claim any of the five requested certifications. The privacy policy at https://www.jackandjill.ai/privacy discusses UK GDPR rights, but does not expressly claim GDPR certification or compliance; that reference is not counted.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The announcement at https://www.jackandjill.ai/blog/series-a explicitly identifies the round as Series A. | funding_date: The Series A announcement at https://www.jackandjill.ai/blog/series-a is dated 15 September 2026, giving the requested month as 2026-09. | funding_amount_usd: The most recent identified funding announcement at https://www.jackandjill.ai/blog/series-a reports a $40 million Series A, equivalent to USD 40,000,000.

raised_18mo.notes: The $40 million Series A announced on 15 September 2026 at https://www.jackandjill.ai/blog/series-a falls within the preceding 18 months.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live Account Executive (SF) posting at https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/jack-jill-external-ats/2fd5e1c5-9f09-4d69-89eb-839393beaf68 includes an application link.

launched_6mo.notes: The announcement at https://www.jackandjill.ai/blog/company-insights launches Company Insights in Jill on 4 November 2026, inside the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Ben Slater's profile at https://linkedin.com/in/ben-slater-96298367 lists a VP Marketing role at Jack & Jill starting in October 2026, within the preceding 12 months.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The readable GTM job at https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/jack-jill-external-ats/b7e19764-25b8-465e-8a41-206ea821ef28 discusses commercial systems without naming a CRM, sales-engagement or marketing-automation platform. The integrations listed at https://www.jackandjill.ai/docs are ATS products and Slack, rather than qualifying CRM or sales/marketing systems.
